children: PennantPark Floating Rate Capital declared a $0.0833 per share monthly distribution for September, payable Oct. 1, 2026.
$0.0833 per share distribution for September 2026: $0.08 base + $0.0033 supplemental.
Payable October 1, 2026 to shareholders of record as of September 15, 2026.
Distribution expected to be paid from taxable net investment income; tax details on Form 1099 after year-end.
As a RIC, portions that are interest-related dividends may be exempt from U.S. withholding tax for eligible non-U.S. shareholders.
